parts.label: (b)

[M1] Obtain the quotient $8x^2-2x-3$ with no errors; stating $(x+7)(8x^2-2x-3)$ is sufficient, and working from part (a) must be restated here. [A1] Total: 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use $(x+7)(8x^2-2x-3)=(x+7)(4x-3)(2x+1)$ with $x=\cos\theta$, solve the quadratic, and obtain an angle from $\cos\theta=-1/2$ or $\cos\theta=3/4$. [M1] Obtain one answer, e.g. $120^\circ$. [A1] Obtain the other three answers $240^\circ,41.4^\circ,318.6^\circ$ (condone $319^\circ$) and no others; more accurate values allowed, while radians give maximum 2/3. [A1] Total: 3.
